notes:
AUDIT E1 (Opus, cold). Accuracy: 25 sampled (random.seed(7)), all sources re-fetched raw; 3 wrong (Automobile, Socks, Casual dining: navbox links on Wikipedia 'List of game manufacturers'). 22 shown and supported; but several correct rows are weak fits (Review and Herald = Adventist book publisher; The Game Crafter = print-on-demand; Necromancer/Palladium = RPG books).

WHOLE-FILE CHECKS (scripts in AUDIT_E1_tmp/scripts, raw pages in AUDIT_E1_tmp/*.md and pages/):
(1) List of game manufacturers, 213 rows, parsed against the raw page (lgm.md): 108 rows are NOT in the list body at all (footer navbox 'Lists of companies' entries such as Lingerie, Oil and gas, Hedge funds, Pornography, Tractors, plus 't','e') -> all 108 in drop. Of the 105 real rows, 104 have their own Wikipedia article and 1 (TDC Games) has none -> listed. Of the 104: 49 are role-playing-game-only publishers (books, not table games with pieces; tier listed or move to the books category): Apex Publications, Arc Dream Publishing, Bards and Sages, Biohazard Games, Black Industries, Blacksburg Tactical Research Center, British Isles Traveller Support, Cakebread & Walton, Crafty Games, Different Worlds, Dream Pod 9, Exile Games Studio, Fantasy Games Unlimited, Fantasy Productions, FASA Corporation, Green Knight Publishing, Grimoire Games, Holistic Design, Issaries, Inc., Judges Guild, Kobold Press, Margaret Weis Productions, Ltd, Mind Storm Labs, Misfit Studios, Monte Cook, Necromancer Games, Neogames, Nightfall Games, Palladium Books, Pariah Press, Partizan Press, Pelgrane Press, Phage Press, Precis Intermedia, R. Talsorian Games, Reindeer Games, Ronin Arts, Sovereign Press, Inc, Spica Publishing, Sword & Sorcery Studios, Target Games, Tri Tac Games, Troll Lord Games, Vajra Enterprises, Victory Games, Wicked Dead Brewing Company; 9 are wargame/miniatures-only (listed unless award-backed); 46 board/card/dice/misc (cultural OK; Testor = model paints, C4). Video-game firms Bethesda Softworks, THQ, Melbourne House, Humanhead Studios -> E5 (in drop).
(2) Spiel des Jahres (sdj.md): 46/47 publisher names found verbatim; Ystari Games is NOT on the page (re-source to fr.wikipedia As d'or page, which names Ystari). 'Space Cow' is the page's own typo for Space Cowboys; 'Pegasus games' and 'Schmidt Games' are the page's English forms of Pegasus Spiele / Schmidt Spiele -> merges listed.
(3) Origin Awards: only 9 of 70 rows are on the cited winners page; the other 61 come from the per-year PDFs linked from it (not the cited src). Sampled 4 PDFs raw (2005, 2010, 2015, 2024): all 21 harvested names checked in them appear (Ad Astra, Dark Sword, Brigade, Clash of Arms, Guardians of Order, Academy, Catalyst, Margaret Weis, Battlefront, Arcane Wonders, White Wizard, IELLO, The Spoils USA, Ares, Osprey, CMON, Hachette Boardgames USA, R2i, Greater Than Games, Hit Point Press, Possum Creek). Hand copying looks accurate; the src should point to the year PDF. Caveat: some Origins wins are for fiction/books (Guardians of Order fiction, Archaia game-related book, Osprey rules supplement) -> those publishers should not be premium for E1 objects.
(4) As d'Or: the 6 Philibert rows (Le Scorpion Masqué, Playpunk, Grail Games, Helvetiq, Auzou, KYF Edition) are all named in visible text of the fr.wikipedia 'As d'or Jeu de l'année' winners tables (asdor_fr.md; KYF as 'KYF Éditions'); re-source them there. That page also yields 20 further publishers (added).
(5) Erzgebirge-Palace (87 rows), Channapatna/Kondapalli shop sites, Waldorfshop, Ostheimer, Kendama USA, Kurokigoishi, Playsafe: existence-only shop/menu pages -> tier listed (SELLER PRAISE rule), except where an independent page exists (Channapatna and Kondapalli now have Wikipedia GI pages, see add_regions).
(6) Merges (in drop as 'merge into'): Pegasus Games/Pegasus Spiele, Schmidt Games/Schmidt Spiele, Amigo/Amigo Spiele, Blue Orange/Blue Orange Games, Mindware Spiele/Mindware (Oppenheim), Pressman x2, Space Cow/Space Cowboys, Scorpion Masqué/Le Scorpion Masqué, Asmodée Éditions->Asmodee, Mattel Games->Mattel, Habermaaß x2->HABA, CMON/CMON Limited/CoolMiniOrNot, Hess/Hess toys, FurReal/FurReal Friends and 15 corporate-suffix doubles. Not merges (homonyms): Oxford (Korean block toys) vs Oxford Games (UK); Plan B Games vs Plan B Toys; Pearl Games vs Pearl drums (E3); Kewpie doll vs Kewpie mayonnaise (J5).
(7) Other drops: Yowie (chocolate), Model Car Hall of Fame (institution), 'The Railway Series and Thomas & Friends merchandise' (article title), Review and Herald Publishing Association.

OMISSIONS ADDED (79 brands, 9 regions), all from fetched pages: heritage/tradition makers and sellers (Hamleys royal warrant, Lotería Don Clemente, Sergiev Posad Toy Factory No.1 and Sergievskaya Igrushka, Six Brothers Baduk, Kofi Tall Games oware, Wooden Story and the Łoboz family (Poland), alebrije masters Manuel Jiménez/Isidoro Cruz/María Jiménez Ojeda, EPV Les Petites Maries/Wilson Jeux/Billards Toulet); quality summit (Käthe Kruse, Lenci, Hermann Coburg [own site; listed unless independently confirmed], Kösener Spielzeug, Rechapados Ferrer, GAN Cube); cultural icons the harvest skipped because it read company categories only (Barbie, Play-Doh, Etch A Sketch, Lite-Brite, Spirograph, Super Soaker, G.I.
